title: Senior Backend Engineer
description:
Senior Backend Engineer, Payments Core.

You will lead the design of payment orchestration services, mentor a team of four to six engineers, and set the technical direction for the payments core roadmap.

Requirements:
- 8-12 years of backend engineering experience, with at least 3 years leading technical work.
- Deep experience with distributed systems, Kafka, and PostgreSQL at scale.
- Track record of owning a critical system end to end, including its on-call burden.
- Experience with Kubernetes in production.

This role carries formal technical leadership expectations.
